description:

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply or share their profiles.

description:
🚀
**WE’RE HIRING | Salesforce Administrator – Integration & Analytics**

📍
**Location:**
Kerala, India

🏢
**Work Mode:**
Hybrid

💼
**Experience:**
7–14 Years

💰
**Salary:**
₹8–20 LPA

📌
**Employment Type:**
Full-time

🌟 Take Your Salesforce Career to the Next Level!

We are hiring an experienced
**Salesforce Administrator – Integration & Analytics**
for one of our clients.

Are you passionate about Salesforce administration, workflow automation, system integrations, and data-driven business solutions? This is an exciting opportunity to work with enterprise Salesforce environments, improve business processes, and collaborate with global stakeholders.

If you have strong Salesforce administration skills and enjoy solving technical challenges, we'd love to hear from you!

💼 What You'll Do

🔹
**Salesforce Administration:**
Manage users, profiles, roles, permission sets, sharing rules, objects, fields, and platform configurations.

🔹
**Workflow Automation:**
Build and maintain Salesforce Flow, approval processes, validation rules, notifications, and declarative automation.

🔹
**API Integrations:**
Configure, maintain, and troubleshoot integrations using Salesforce APIs, REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, and OAuth.

🔹
**Reports & Analytics:**
Develop Salesforce reports and dashboards to support business decisions and improve data visibility.

🔹
**Data Quality:**
Maintain data accuracy, governance, secure data exchange, and reliable reporting processes.

🔹
**Troubleshooting:**
Resolve platform, integration, and user issues while identifying opportunities for continuous improvement.

🔹
**Release Management:**
Support sandbox environments, testing, deployments, and change documentation.

🔹
**Stakeholder Collaboration:**
Work closely with U.S.-based business stakeholders, developers, and technology teams to translate requirements into scalable solutions.

🎯 What We're Looking For

✅ 7–14 years of relevant professional experience, with strong hands-on Salesforce administration expertise.

✅ Strong knowledge of
**Salesforce Administration, Salesforce Flow, and Salesforce APIs**
.

✅ Practical experience with REST/SOAP APIs, JSON, OAuth, SOQL, and integration troubleshooting.

✅ Experience developing Salesforce reports and dashboards.

✅ Familiarity with Sales Cloud and/or Service Cloud.

✅ Understanding of data quality management, security, access controls, and platform configuration.

✅ Strong problem-solving, communication, documentation, and analytical skills.

✅ Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with distributed teams.

⭐ Skills That Give You an Edge

✨ Microsoft Power BI, dashboard development, and data modelling.

✨ Salesforce Administrator certification.

✨ Sandbox management, deployment processes, and Salesforce DevOps.

✨ Apex, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Platform Events, or middleware tools.

✨ Experience Cloud, Agentforce, Einstein, or other AI-assisted Salesforce capabilities.

*You don't need every preferred skill to apply. Strong Salesforce administration, automation, and integration experience are the key priorities.*

🚀 Why Consider This Opportunity?

🌟 Work on enterprise Salesforce administration and integration challenges.

🌟 Gain exposure to analytics, reporting, and automation initiatives.

🌟 Collaborate with U.S.-based stakeholders and cross-functional technology teams.

🌟 Enjoy a hybrid working model in Kerala.

🌟 Competitive compensation of ₹8–20 LPA, based on experience and expertise.

📩
**Interested in this opportunity?**

Apply Now !

Know someone who would be a great fit? Tag them or share this opportunity with your network. Let's connect with talented Salesforce professionals! 🚀

title: Power Apps Developer
description:
* Lead the administration and governance of the Microsoft Power Platform ecosystem, including environment strategy, managed environments, security, access controls, and compliance standards.
* Define, implement, and maintain Data Loss Prevention (DLP) policies to ensure secure and compliant use of Power Platform connectors and services.
* Design, develop, and oversee scalable Power Apps, Power Automate, and Power Platform solutions that support enterprise-wide user adoption and business needs.
* Establish and manage Power Platform Application Lifecycle Management (ALM) processes, including solution management, deployment pipelines, release governance, and CI/CD automation.
* Monitor platform health, application performance, usage trends, and operational metrics, proactively identifying risks, bottlenecks, and optimization opportunities.
* Develop dashboards, reports, and analytics to provide insights into application adoption, platform utilization, governance compliance, and overall operational effectiveness.
* Evaluate and implement native AI capabilities such as AI Builder and Copilot technologies to improve business processes, automation, and decision-making.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, developers, and administrators to translate business requirements into secure, scalable, and maintainable Power Platform solutions.
* Provide guidance, governance standards, and best practices for Power Platform development teams and citizen developers.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on platform reliability, performance, scalability, security, and user experience.

**What is the expectation from the candidate’s current role/profile?**

* Demonstrated experience as a Power Platform Architect, Administrator, Lead Developer, or Platform Engineer managing enterprise-scale Power Platform implementations.
* Strong hands-on expertise in Power Platform administration, governance, environment management, security controls, and DLP policy management.
* Proven track record of designing and supporting large-scale Power Apps and automation solutions with high availability, performance, and maintainability.
* Experience implementing ALM strategies, deployment pipelines, DevOps practices, and controlled release management across multiple environments.
* Strong understanding of Power Platform licensing, security architecture, compliance requirements, and governance frameworks.
* Experience leveraging AI Builder, Copilot, and other Microsoft AI capabilities to solve business problems and improve operational efficiency.
* Ability to analyze platform metrics, develop monitoring frameworks, and provide actionable insights through dashboards and reporting solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to work across technical and business teams.
* Ability to provide technical leadership, establish best practices, mentor team members, and drive adoption of Power Platform capabilities across the organization

title: SAP DRC Consultant
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

1. Solution Design & Configuration

* Configure and maintain the SAP DRC framework, including the eDocument Cockpit, Application Interface Framework (AIF), and statutory reporting functionalities.
* Map legal requirements from various countries into standard SAP DRC capabilities (e.g., CTC mandates, e-way bills, SAF-T, and localized VAT reporting).
* Collaborate with integration teams to establish secure connections between SAP and tax authority portals via SAP BTP Integration Suite (CPI) or API management.

2. Business Analysis & Compliance

* Partner with Global Tax and Finance teams to monitor changing international tax legislations and translate them into technical SAP specifications.
* Analyze existing financial processes (AP, AR, GL) to optimize tax determination, pricing procedures, and master data for seamless e-invoice generation.

3. Support & Maintenance

* Troubleshoot and resolve day-to-day transaction errors within the eDocument Cockpit and AIF monitors.
* Apply SAP Notes, Support Packages, and regulatory updates (such as legal changes delivered via SAP OSS) to keep the compliance framework up to date.

**Job Qualifications & Requirements**

**Education & Experience**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
* Experience:
* Minimum of 5+ years of hands-on experience in SAP FI/CO modules.
* At least 2–3 years of specialized experience working with SAP DRC (formerly SAP eDocument and Advanced Compliance Reporting - ACR).
* Proven experience in at least one full-lifecycle global rollout involving local e-invoicing mandates (e.g., Italy SDI, Poland KSeF, France Chorus Pro, Romania RO e-Factura
* Expert knowledge of SAP Indirect Tax (VAT/GST) setup, with deep experience in complex EU tax rules within large MNC environments.
* ABAP debugging skills to troubleshoot complex tax calculation and interface issues.
* Excellent communication and problem solving skills

title: Lead Product validation Engineer – I/O Sensors
description:
**Job Requirements**
At Quest Global, it’s not just what we do but how and why we do it that makes us different. With over 25 years as an engineering services provider, we believe in the power of doing things differently to make the impossible possible. Our people are driven by the desire to make the world a better place—to make a positive difference that contributes to a brighter future. We bring together technologies and industries, alongside the contributions of diverse individuals who are empowered by an intentional workplace culture, to solve problems better and faster.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
We are seeking a talented
**I/O Stream Lead Hardware Engineer**
to join our Hardware Engineering team. This role focuses on designing, developing, and optimizing input/output sensors and data streaming interfaces for next-Generation hardware products. You will work on cutting-edge technologies that enable seamless communication between hardware components, sensors, and processing units.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Hardware Validation & Testing: Develop and execute comprehensive test plans to validate hardware functionality, performance, and reliability across I/O sensors
* Own validation for all device I/O interfaces, such as:
* Dock interfaces, smart cases, charging cradles
* Debug interfaces (UART/JTAG/SWD), factory ports, test pads
* Experience on sensors related validation such as magnetometer, ambient light, proximity, temperature, humidity etc.
* Haptics/LEDs/buttons/touch interface validation (GPIO, interrupts, latency)
* Define interface-level requirements, acceptance criteria, and coverage mapped to product use-cases.
* Test Automation: Create Python-based automation scripts and frameworks for hardware testing, data collection, and regression testing
* Hardware Verification: Create and execute test benches using Hardware Verification Languages (HVL) to validate I/O functionality
* Sensor Integration: Design and implement camera interfaces, image sensors, and other sensor I/O systems
* Power Management: Optimize power consumption for I/O subsystems while maintaining performance requirements
* Firmware Integration: Collaborate with firmware teams to ensure seamless integration of hardware interfaces with device drivers
* Scripting & Tooling: Develop automation tools and scripts to streamline hardware validation workflows and improve test coverage
* Documentation: Maintain comprehensive design documentation, test reports, and technical specifications

We are known for our extraordinary people who make the impossible possible every day.
  
  
Questians are driven by hunger, humility, and aspiration. We believe that our company culture is the key to our ability to make a true difference in every industry we reach. Our teams regularly invest time and dedicated effort into internal culture work, ensuring that all voices are heard.
  
  
We wholeheartedly believe in the diversity of thought that comes with fostering a culture rooted in respect, where everyone belongs, is valued, and feels inspired to share their ideas. We know embracing our unique differences makes us better, and that solving the worlds hardest engineering problems requires diverse ideas, perspectives, and backgrounds. We shine the brightest when we tap into the many dimensions that thrive across over 21,000 difference-makers in our workplace.
  
  
**Work Experience**
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Electrical/Computer Engineering/Electronics(or related), or equivalent experience.
* 9+ years experience in product validation, systems test, or HW/SW integration for consumer electronics (wearables, mobile, XR/AR).
* Proficiency in Python scripting for test automation and hardware control
* Experience with hardware validation methodologies and test plan development
* Experience with FPGA-based prototyping and ASIC development
* Strong debugging and troubleshooting skills using lab equipment
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with consumer electronics or wearable devices.
* Experience with Python libraries for hardware automation
* Familiarity with automation frameworks for hardware testing
* Experience with camera/display interfaces
* Knowledge of real-time operating systems Android Debugging Skills (ADB)

**Benefits**

* Work on cutting-edge Next-generation consumer electronics hardware
* Work on High-bandwidth data streaming solutions
* Automated hardware validation and test infrastructure
* Collaborate with world-class engineers and product teams.
* Opportunity to grow as a technical leader in a fast-paced, innovative environment.

title: WordPress Developer
description:
Role Overview
   

  

 Design, customize, and maintain WordPress websites that deliver seamless functionality, engaging user experiences, and strong performance across digital platforms. The WordPress Developer role focuses on building and maintaining client websites using WordPress. Responsibilities include developing custom themes and plugins, integrating APIs, and optimizing sites for speed, SEO, and security. This position requires strong technical expertise in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, along with the ability to collaborate with designers, content teams, and clients. It offers opportunities to work on diverse projects, ensuring responsive design, accessibility, and long‑term scalability.
   

  

 Key Responsibilities
   

  

* Develop custom WordPress themes and plugins using PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript
* Customize websites with tools such as Gutenberg, Elementor, and Advanced Custom Fields (ACF)
* Integrate APIs including payment gateways and social media platforms
* Optimize websites for performance, SEO, and security using caching and security plugins
* Troubleshoot and debug WordPress issues to ensure smooth functionality
* Collaborate with designers, content teams, and clients for project success
* Ensure responsive design, accessibility, and cross‑browser compatibility
* Document code, workflows, and processes for future reference


**Requirements**
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field (BCA, MCA, BSc Computer Science, B‑Tech in CS)
* Minimum of 1 years of professional experience in WordPress development
* Proficiency in PHP, HTML, CSS, and JavaScript (jQuery, React optional)
* Experience with custom/child themes, plugins, and WP‑CLI
* Familiarity with SEO, caching tools (W3 Total Cache, WP Rocket), and security plugins (Wordfence)
* Strong knowledge of responsive and accessible design principles
* Experience with Git/GitHub for version control
* Problem‑solving, communication, and client management skills
